author: Tesla
description:
Autobidder is Tesla's energy trading and battery optimization service, designed for Megapack. With Autobidder, battery operators let Tesla handle energy trading for them and share the revenue from wholesale electricity markets. 

The Chevire project is located in Nantes in the west of France on the site of a previous coal plant. Here Megapack provides clean, reliable and affordable energy for the local community.

Learn more: https://www.tesla.com/megapack
title: Autobidder | Tesla Megapack
